Widow Halloran (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 45 lines between E1 and E14

Arc [mock] Part 1: Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
E2: The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain.
CLIP: [On screen: Low angle on the widow framed against the lighthouse beam.]
a figure in period dress: "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
[Sound: A string sting swells to a peak.]
[On screen: Close-up on the widow's hands gripping the rail.]
a figure in period dress: "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
[On screen: Over-the-shoulder shot from the widow toward the man in period dress.]
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
a man in period dress: "I saw who slipped the ring into your shawl."
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the figure in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
a figure in period dress: "The council has already decided her fate."
[On screen: High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.]
a figure in period dress (off-screen): "You think a scarred stranger can save you?"
[On screen: Medium two-shot of the man in period dress and the figure in period dress, the space between them charged.]
a figure in period dress: "Drink deep, little lamp-keeper."
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the figure in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
a figure in period dress: "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
